data.trent: The Tunisians fought for Sardinia, yes- and were justly rewarded. But Sicily has been Andalusi blood. Andalusi steel. Andalusi sweat. And while the Tunisians started this war- they... understand our desire for compensation. Namely- Sicily.

title: A new ṭāʾifa will be raised in Sicily once the Mamlūks' war, al-Andalus's other and nominal war, is over

Athens, a Christian duchy that stands against the Turks and the Neapolitans and had been Sicily's nominal vassal, will neither stand alone nor swear to its old enemies. It offers the Emperor fealty for autonomy, and he accepts

data.duke: Peter of the house of Barcelona, born 1399, a kinsman of the last king of Sicily; the admiral whose single ship attacked the prince Yūsuf's squadron off Terracina in January 1448
data.lands: Athens, Atalanti, Salona, Angelokastron, Karpenisi, Loidoriki: some 270,000 souls, Greek and mostly Catholic
